_ConnectionStrings_note: Passwords are injected at runtime (ConnectionStrings__App / ConnectionStrings__Admin via env var / user-secrets); never committed. App = pol_app (RLS-scoped, merchant-facing, the default path). Admin = pol_admin (RLS-bypass) used ONLY by the cross-merchant provisioning endpoints (POST /api/v1/merchants, GET /api/v1/merchants/{code}).

Google._Oidc_note: Confidential OIDC client for the admin BFF login (REQ-1/2/8). ClientId/ClientSecret are the admin 'Web application' Google client; the secret is injected at runtime (Google__Oidc__ClientSecret), never committed. Blank here -> fail-fast at boot outside Development. The merchant-user side runs its own separate OIDC BFF (MerchantUser:Oidc below) — there is no shared Google id-token Bearer plumbing left (T5's single-scheme session cookie).

_AdminSession_note: Server-side admin session lifetime + cookie posture (REQ-3/5/7). SameSite=Lax assumes admin SPA + API are same-site; set None for a cross-site deploy. ReturnUrlAllowlist is the open-redirect allowlist for post-login returnTo (same-origin paths only).
_MerchantUser_note: Merchant-user BFF login (producer-google-sso REQ-8/9/14/17). A SECOND confidential OIDC client, fully isolated from Google:Oidc (the admin one): distinct 'MerchantUserGoogle' scheme + /api/v1/merchants/users/auth/callback + mch_* cookies. Oidc.ClientId/ClientSecret are the merchant-user 'Web application' Google client; the secret is injected at runtime (MerchantUser__Oidc__ClientSecret), never committed. Blank ClientId here -> the merchant-user OIDC scheme is skipped (merchant-user login disabled) rather than faulting the host. RegisterUrl is the merchant-user SPA register page the callback redirects an applicant to with a signed ticket. Session = server-side session lifetime + cookie posture (SameSite=Lax assumes merchant-user SPA + API same-site).
_AdminAllowlist_note: Bootstrap allowlist for the first Super admin(s): Google subjects allowed to self-provision as Super on first login (admin-actor-rename REQ-5). Empty here; set per env via AdminAllowlist__Subjects__0. Bootstrap-only gate — removing a subject does NOT revoke an existing admin (suspend via POST /api/v1/admins/{id}/suspend). Empty outside Development logs a fail-closed boot warning.
_Cors_note: Browser SPA frontend origins. AllowedOrigins = merchant-user console (cookie XHR, credentialed — the default policy); AdminOrigins = admin console (cookie XHR, credentialed). Empty here (no cross-origin allowed); set per env via Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 / Cors__AdminOrigins__0.
